{{Quote|Used to be I worked for Nem'ro's gang. Violent, bloody life. That's why I left. But now my little brother's following in my footsteps.|Lew Brell explains his brother's predicament to an Imperial-aligned individual|<ref name="Gangs" />}}
'''Cam Brell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Cam grew up with an older brother named [[Lew Brell|Lew]], who at one point served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] in the industrial [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]]. Lew eventually left [[Nem'ro's gang]], but Cam decided to follow in his brother's footsteps and joined the gang himself. During a fight between Nem'ro's men and those of a rival Hutt named [[Voontara Fa'athra]], Cam lost his nerve and attempted to surrender and join Fa'athra's men. Cam, however, was captured by Nem'ro's street captain, [[Rex Geer]], and imprisoned for his treachery. Lew hired an Imperial-aligned individual to get his brother to leave the gang, whom he believed were simply pinned down by Fa'athra's men. The individual arrived at Geer's house where Cam was imprisoned and discovered his predicament. Geer, who had previously known Lew, claimed that the younger brother was to be brought before Nem'ro and offered to [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|pay]] the individual to leave the Brell to his fate. The individual agreed, much to Cam's horror, and left without him despite his protests.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No, please. Please!|Cam, left to his fate.|<ref name="Gangs" />}}
[[File:Cam_Brell.png|thumb|left|150px|Cam was imprisoned for deserting Nemro's forces.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Brell lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Gangs" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Codex Hutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> with his elder brother, [[Lew Brell]], who worked for a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. Brell eventually left [[Nem'ro's gang]], however, as he began to feel the work was too violent. In the year [[3643 BBY]], Cam decided to follow in his brother's footsteps and joined Nem'ro's gang as Lew had. Cam found himself in a fight alongside Nem'ro's men against a rival Hutt named [[Voontara Fa'athra]] in an industrial town on Hutta named [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="Gangs" /> which Nem'ro ruled.<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> Cam, however, lost his nerve during the fighting and attempted to surrender and join the opposing forces. Geer, who was working for Nem'ro as the captain of his street gang, caught Cam attempting to change sides and imprisoned the traitor, intending to take him before Nem'ro. Whilst Cam was imprisoned, Lew began searching for someone to help save his brother from the gang.<ref name="Gangs" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Lew found an Imperial-aligned individual in the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Jiguuna who was willing to help him save Cam. The individual successfully fought their way through Fa'athra's men and reached [[Rex Geer's house]], where Rex and Cam were holding up along with three other prisoners. The individual discovered Cam within a cage in the house and asked Rex for his release. The captain instead offered the individual credits to leave Cam in his custody and tell Lew that Cam had been killed in the fighting. The individual agreed, much to Cam's horror, and left Geer's house, returning to Lew at the cantina. As the individual left, Geer taunted Cam, who cried out and pleaded with the individual not to leave.<ref name="Gangs" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The Brell kid's a traitor. First time Fa'athra's thugs start shooting at us, he turns coward and tries to join their side.|Rex Geer|<ref name="Gangs" />}}
Cam Brell respected his elder brother enough to follow his career choice and join Nem'ro's gang. In the gang, however, he proved less brave than his brother as he attempted to surrender and join the opposing force during a fight with Fa'athra's thugs. When Rex Geer informed Cam that the individual Lew had sent to save him was leaving him, Cam cried out in dismay, begging the individual for mercy.<ref name="Gangs" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Th--thank you!|Cam's dialogue if the player saves him.|<ref name="Gangs" />}}
Cam Brell first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, Brell is located in the town of Jiguuna, on the planet Nal Hutta, the location in which players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class start the game. Brell is involved in the quest "Gang Warfare", where his brother asks the player to save him. The player has a choice, upon finding Cam, to either leave him to his fate in exchange for credits ([[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]), or to save him ([[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]). This article assumes that players chose the "dark side" option and left Cam, as only players of the Imperial faction, specifically Imperial Agents and Bounty Hunters, can take this mission. If the player leaves Cam, when they return to Lew they can choose to tell him the truth about leaving Cam or claim he was already [[Death/Legends|dead]] when they arrived. Neither of these options corresponds with a specific alignment, so this article makes no assumption about which was chosen.
